'''2022 EGP Paul Coggins DS Mustafar CRv''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Coggins]] at [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Paul Coggins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V)|V0-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Readiness (V) Coggins DS.txt |Download]]
